verdict: Leans toward the stop: at 2R the target has to come first in 33 % of the replays that hit one side; it did in 22 % (target first 7.8 % vs stop first 28.4 %).
verdict_notes: 63.8 % of the replays hit neither by 4:00 PM; the price at 4:00 PM decides those.
Average R is +0.099 all the same: the replays that hit neither pull it the other way.
note: A simulation built from AMZN's own last 59 full sessions. It is not a prediction: earnings, news and halts can do things those sessions never did. Same seed, same numbers.
